note: Scenarios of the installed-package contract (suite installed: bindings/python/tests/installed.py, bindings/powershell/tests/installed.ps1, run by dev.py test --suite installed) and of native operator acceptance (suite native: dev.py test --suite native --interactive). The release gate's automated desktop journeys are listed by tools/gate/verdict.py and described in docs/DEVELOPMENT.md. Evidence is specific to a source revision and its packaged artifacts; this file records no results.

scenarios.title: Clean install
scenarios.acceptance: Install the exact candidate outside the checkout; import without a compiler, the checkout or a PATH native fallback; the package loads its own native payload and a headless session completes; a fresh process with the payload removed fails clearly.

scenarios.title: Native startup
scenarios.acceptance: On a real desktop, open a visible window from the installed binding; check title, first paint, responsiveness, shutdown and structured initialization errors.

scenarios.title: Input and state change
scenarios.acceptance: Use real pointer and keyboard input: edit text including combining characters, select/copy/paste/undo, activate buttons and labels, change checkboxes and radios, scroll, and see state updates and resize layout. Synthetic headless events do not count as desktop evidence.

scenarios.title: Window lifetime and resize
scenarios.acceptance: Open two windows; resize, minimize and restore; close one while the other stays responsive; confirm logical/physical dimensions and stale-handle errors.

scenarios.title: Close veto and forced stop
scenarios.acceptance: Veto a user close once, then allow it; forced application stop bypasses veto and releases all windows with final close notification.

scenarios.title: Owner thread dispatch
scenarios.acceptance: Post work from a supported worker context; native UI mutation executes on its owner; direct wrong-thread calls fail clearly without hanging.

scenarios.title: Cancellation and stop races
scenarios.acceptance: Queue work and timers while stopping; every accepted task has one terminal outcome; no callback executes against disposed windows or after final cleanup.

scenarios.title: Same process native reuse
scenarios.acceptance: Open/run/close several sessions in one host process; handles remain distinct, the native loop is reused safely, and a previous error has defined recovery behavior.

scenarios.title: ABI and callback lifetime
scenarios.acceptance: Check ABI, retain callbacks through a run, propagate callback failures after cleanup, reject stale identifiers, and exercise bounded native lifetime.

scenarios.title: Bounds and idle behavior
scenarios.acceptance: Record explicit limit errors and idle behavior; no unbounded queue or busy-spin; resize does not allocate beyond documented bounds. Record measurement conditions.

scenarios.title: Resources and diagnostics
scenarios.acceptance: Load UTF-8 HTML with a local stylesheet and image from a path with spaces and Unicode outside the checkout. Preserve the source base, verify that CSS and asynchronous image loading change rendered output, reject missing or denied resources clearly, and obtain native build/source/platform diagnostics.

scenarios.title: Release and upgrade identity
scenarios.acceptance: Verify package and native version and the exact candidate source identity in a fresh consumer, and that a reinstall of the same candidate keeps that identity. Upgrades from published releases are covered by tests/packaging/upgrade_matrix.py; publication is a separate step.

scenarios.title: 0.3 document contract
scenarios.acceptance: Batch operations and trimming, follow-scroll, into-view geometry, move/append/read, selection copy, clipboard and the default-action rule behave as documented on the headless backend.

scenarios.title: 0.4 dialogs and windows
scenarios.acceptance: Modal dialog focus, select and return value, window actions and size constraints, and headless file-dialog completion.

scenarios.title: 0.5 capabilities and accessible text
scenarios.acceptance: The capability report gives a status and cause for every feature; the media environment override applies; per-line accessible text reports the caret.

scenarios.title: 0.6 DOM, style and form contract
scenarios.acceptance: HTML serialization, stylesheets, node traversal and stale references, text geometry, computed style, validity, file input and link policy.

scenarios.title: 0.7 desktop services contract
scenarios.acceptance: Desktop services refuse honestly without a desktop; menu accelerators, pointer-grab status and sanitized rich clipboard.

scenarios.title: 0.8 popover and scrolling contract
scenarios.acceptance: Popover show/toggle, scroll snapping, smooth scrolling, pointer capture only during a press, and range sanitizing.

scenarios.title: 0.9 layout and animation contract
scenarios.acceptance: field-sizing, content-visibility, CSS animations parse and compute, and the inline SVG box.

scenarios.title: 1.0 paging, editing and background work
scenarios.acceptance: Pagination, page rectangles, PDF export, rich editing, diagnostics schema 1, and background work that settles once on the owner thread.
